resources.string: Complete medical backup
Includes records, all retained libraries and retained attachment versions. The ordinary HRT Log record backup does not include original files.
Export complete backup
Restore complete backup
Choose one file in the system picker.
Authenticated format %1$d · libraries %2$d · attachment versions %3$d
Confirmation creates a new active library and retains the old library. Nothing is replaced before authentication and the authority transaction commits.
Confirm full restore
Complete encrypted archive written. Keep the password separately.
Restore transaction committed. Reopen the library; old requests remain invalid.
Reopen library
The restore outcome is uncertain. Check its journal; do not submit the file again.
Check status only
No journal for this operation was found in the authorized root. No restore success is confirmed. Starting a new task requires an explicit new file selection.
This operation committed; it may no longer be the active library. Reopen to inspect.
The verified journal is incomplete. Old data remains; no automatic retry will run.
Cancel incomplete restore
This only marks the verified pending operation aborted. Ciphertext, keys and used reservations remain retained; no space is promised back.
Unable to complete. Password, format, corruption, authorization or storage may be the cause. No restore success is confirmed; an output file may be incomplete.
Cancelled. An export file may be incomplete; no restore success is implied.
Access ended. Reopen after authorization; no file is reopened automatically.
This password protects a portable medical archive. It is not the app PIN. It is never saved; keep a separate copy.
